name: iCTRL
subtitle: AI 手机自动化引擎
description: OpenMinis iCTRL 的 AltStore / SideStore 源。自动跟随 GitHub Releases 更新。

apps.name: iCTRL Runner
apps.subtitle: 自动化执行引擎（必装）
apps.localizedDescription:
XCUITest 自动化引擎。常驻后台，在 8200 端口提供 JSON-RPC 2.0 服务，让 AI 代理可以点击、滑动、输入、读取任意 App 的界面。

装好后从桌面点一下图标启动；它没有前台界面，会闪一下进入后台，随后在通知栏显示「iCTRL Server Ready」。

前提：开发者磁盘镜像（DDI）已挂载。重启手机后需要重新挂载。

versions.localizedDescription:
An AI-friendly iOS/iPadOS automation service. Tell your agent *"My iPhone is running iCTRL at :8200 — figure out how to drive it."* and it reads the on-device manual and takes it from there. Works with any agent that can make HTTP requests: OpenClaw, Hermes, Minis, Claude Code, Codex and others. ## Downloads ### Which IPA do I need? | File | Needed? | What it is | |---|---|---| | `iCTRLUITests-Runner.ipa` | **Required** | The automation engine. It serves the JSON-RPC API that agents and clients call, and must be running. | | `iCTRL.ipa` | Optional | A companion app for tasks on the phone itself:
• mount the Developer Disk Image without a Mac, and remount it after a reboot
• start and stop the runner
• choose who can reach the runner (this device only / LAN / LAN + nearby)
• see and revoke authorized clients
• read the runner's log live | Skip `iCTRL.ipa` if you mount the Developer Disk Image with Xcode or StikDebug, and manage the runner from its notification or a computer. With a free Apple ID you get three sideloaded apps, and SideStore uses one of them. Install StikDebug *or* the iCTRL app alongside the runner, not both. Both IPAs are unsigned for distribution (ad-hoc, no provisioning profile). Sign them when you install: - **Free Apple ID:** the latest SideStore signs and installs them. Older SideStore releases skip the nested `.xctest`, and the runner then crashes on launch. - **Paid account:** `Scripts/sign-ipa.sh -i iCTRLUITests-Runner.ipa` The runner also needs the Developer Disk Image mounted (Xcode, StikDebug or the iCTRL app). The [README](https://github.com/OpenMinis/iCTRL#installation) covers the whole setup. ## What's new since 1.97.1 ### Nearby discovery: no address to type - **Reach the phone without an address.** Turn on **📡 Nearby Discovery** from the runner's notification or the iCTRL app (it needs Remote Access). Clients can then find the phone: - on the LAN, from any OS; - from a Mac over Apple peer-to-peer Wi-Fi (AWDL), with no shared network at all. The phone only needs Wi-Fi switched on, not joined to anything. - **New client commands:** `python3 ictrl_rpc.py scan` lists discovered phones, and `--nearby ""` replaces `--host`. The first call pairs with the phone (approve once on the phone). - **Strict exposure:** - Nothing is announced on the network unless nearby discovery is on. - The AWDL listener accepts peer-to-peer connections only, and the main listener refuses them. - Nearby discovery can be switched **on** only from the phone itself (notification, iCTRL app or USB). - **Self-healing:** - Advertising follows Wi-Fi off and on, and recovers if the interface is recreated. - A failed listener is rebuilt. - The notification says why nearby discovery isn't ready yet (*turn on Wi-Fi*, *allow Local Network*). ### Who can reach the phone, at a glance - **The status notification's first line** shows one of: 🔒 This device only, 🌐 LAN reachable, or 📡 Nearby discoverable. - **The iCTRL app has a Visibility menu:** 🟢 This device only · safe / 🟡 LAN / 🟡 LAN + nearby. - **LAN addresses are real interfaces only.** VPN or proxy tunnel addresses such as `198.18.0.1` are no longer shown as the phone's address. ### Pairing and keys - **Every pairing is approved on the phone.** The "trusted for 10 minutes" shortcut is gone. - **Limits on requests:** - An unanswered request is refused after 60 s. - Only one request waits at a time, with a 15 s cooldown after a refusal. - Requests from the phone itself have their own slot, so a remote caller can't lock them out. - **Check the key.** The prompt shows a key fingerprint that the client also prints; allow only if they match. - **One key per device.** Clients store keys per device, so a phone paired once works over USB, the LAN and nearby without pairing again. Keys stored under an address by older clients are picked up automatically. - **Local Network permission.** The runner asks for it at launch and repor

apps.name: iCTRL
apps.subtitle: 伴侣管理 App（可选）
apps.localizedDescription:
伴侣 App，负责周边事务：

• 免电脑挂载开发者磁盘镜像（DDI），重启后一键重挂
• 启动 / 停止 Runner，查看运行状态
• 管理已授权客户端，查看来源并吊销
• 实时查看 Runner 日志
• 切换可见性：仅本机 / 局域网 / 附近发现

如果已经用 Xcode 或 StikDebug 挂载 DDI，可以不装这个。
